findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3：公司稱各項訴訟與程序的最終結果預期對合併財務狀況、經營成果或流動性不致有重大影響；未列出反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: We currently believe that the ultimate outcome of such lawsuits and proceedings will not, individually or in the aggregate, have a material effect on our consolidated financial position, results of operations, or liquidity.

findings.claim: 加盟業務受 FTC 規範及各州／各國加盟關係法約束；違規可能導致罰款與民事判決（產業特定監管框架，屬既有風險揭露）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Our franchising business is subject to various laws, as well as to regulations enacted by the Federal Trade Commission ("FTC"). The FTC also regulates the manner and substance of our disclosures to prospective franchisees.

findings.claim: Hyatt 與 Hilton 等被控透過 IDeaS 收益軟體交換價格資訊的民事反托拉斯集體訴訟，法院先行駁回（私人訴訟，非政府調查）。
findings.source: Law360 Hyatt, Hilton Beat Room Price-Fixing Antitrust Suit, For Now
findings.excerpt: Hyatt, Hilton Beat Room Price-Fixing Antitrust Suit, For Now

note: 2026 年搜尋未見針對 Hyatt 的新政府反壟斷調查（DOJ/FTC/EU）；FTC 搜尋廣告共謀調查的報導為付費牆、日期未確認，未列為 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
